description: Unit test class for CanvasController's parseSnapshotParams function, testing JSON parsing and default values.

classes.name: CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest
classes.description: Test class containing unit tests for the parseSnapshotParams method of CanvasController.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsDefaultsToJpeg
methods.description: Tests that passing null to parseSnapshotParams defaults the format to JPEG and nulls other parameters.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesPng
methods.description: Tests parsing of a JSON string specifying PNG format and maxWidth.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesJpegAliases
methods.description: Tests that 'jpeg' and 'jpg' aliases are both interpreted as JPEG format.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsClampsQuality
methods.description: Tests that quality values outside expected range are clamped to valid bounds.
